# Brycen Wood

> Business automation consultant who builds custom operating systems for small
> businesses using Claude Code. Non-technical founder. No coding experience.
> Built 80+ automations for his own vehicle wrap company (Summit Wraps --
> $52K to $300K revenue growth, without adding a single employee). Now offers
> the same to other businesses. Starts with a $1,500 diagnosis (90 minutes,
> written plan in 5 business days, credited against a build within 30 days).

## Services
- [Pricing](https://www.brycenwood.com/pricing/) - Diagnosis $1,500 (credited against a build). Setup Day $2,500 (Claude Code set up on your machine, one working system). Builds are fixed price, quoted after a diagnosis.
- [Custom Build](https://www.brycenwood.com/services/custom-build/) - One named system built, tested and handed over. Fixed price, quoted after a diagnosis.
- [Retainer](https://www.brycenwood.com/services/retainer/) - After a build only: monitoring, fixes, small changes, monthly review. $1,500/month, 3-month minimum.
- [5-Week Cohort](https://www.brycenwood.com/cohort/) - Run your business on Claude Code: 5 evenings plus a Setup Day, 8 to 12 owners, Utah County with a Zoom seat. $1,500.

## Service Area
- Remote / nationwide (United States)
- Custom builds delivered digitally -- no geographic limitation
- In-person discovery calls available in Utah County and Salt Lake County, Utah

## FAQ
- Q: Do I need to know how to code? A: No. Every system is built through conversation with Claude Code. Zero coding experience required. Brycen himself has never written a line of code.
- Q: How long does a build take? A: The hand-off date is written on a one-page scope before work starts, by default 3 weeks from the deposit. Half up front, half at hand-off, 14 days of fixes after.
- Q: Where do I start? A: A $1,500 diagnosis. The full fee comes off a build bought within 30 days.
- Q: Can you build for any type of business? A: Yes. Custom builds are researched and tailored for each client's specific industry. Past builds include vehicle wraps, auto tint, and systems designed for HVAC, coffee shops, steel sales, and more.
- Q: What makes this different from hiring an agency? A: Agencies charge $5K-$20K for just a website. A custom build delivers your entire operating system -- CRM, email automation, lead generation, dashboards, SEO, content pipelines -- in 2 weeks for a fraction of the cost, because AI builds at 10x the speed with 10x less overhead.
